description: This file defines an interface 'INativeJS' in C++ for interacting with NativeJS plugins within the WPEFramework. It declares various virtual methods for initializing, creating, running, and terminating NativeJS applications, but does not contain implementations.

classes.name: INativeJS
classes.description: An interface for managing NativeJS plugins, including methods for initialization, creation, execution, and termination of applications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a Wayland display identifier.

methods.name: CreateApplication
methods.description: Creates a new NativeJS application with specified options and returns its ID.

methods.name: RunApplication
methods.description: Runs an existing NativeJS application specified by ID and URL.

methods.name: RunJavaScript
methods.description: Executes JavaScript code within a specified application identified by ID.

methods.name: GetApplications
methods.description: Retrieves details of all existing NativeJS applications.

methods.name: TerminateApplication
methods.description: Terminates a NativeJS application specified by ID.
